rv.q: Daniel Evans, Jo McInnes and Madeleine Potter — who appeared in the original production a quarter of a century ago — are, as you would expect, very good indeed. Every word of Sarah Kane’s feverish text is made to count. Even the occasional countdown of numbers is given ritualistic weight.
Twenty-Five years ago Sarah Kane’s last play 4.48 PSYCHOSIS was performed at the Royal Court with Daniel Evans, Jo McInnes and Madeleine Potter.
